instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-33_input.step. In the 160 x 90 x 14 mm plate, create six vertical through holes. The holes at (30,25), (130,25), (30,65), and (130,65) are diameter 6 mm; the holes at (80,25) and (80,65) are diameter 8 mm. The two left holes at X=30 have top counterbores of diameter 16 mm and depth 5 mm. The two right holes at X=130 have bottom counterbores of diameter 14 mm and depth 4 mm. The two center holes at X=80 remain ordinary through holes without counterbores. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-33_output.step.
